title: Anthropic cuts off Fable 5 and Mythos 5 access following government order
brief: The US government ordered Anthropic to block global access to its Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models due to unspecified national security concerns, prompting the company to shut down customer access entirely. Anthropic stated the government provided only verbal briefings on alleged vulnerabilities it characterized as minor and available through other models.
